neighbours.label: Two specific word pieces in non-English text: Russian 'по горизонтали' (horizontally, along the horizontal) and the stem 'inaugur-' in Spanish/Italian participles and nouns (inaugurado, inaugurada, inaugurato, inauguración, inaugurazione). Quiet for горизонт, горизонтальный/горизонтальную, 'horizontal' in other languages, the infinitives inaugurar/inaugurer, and English horizontally/inaugurated.
neighbours.unit_kind: broad (1.1% of tokens >0.1 max); label covers only its two context-robust triggers
neighbours.notes: Cold step-in reader (drop 0.03 when the feeder is zeroed); label has nothing to do with the feeder's 'today'. Pole is broad: many tops are mid-word pieces in long Russian/Spanish/French passages that do not reproduce in fresh frames. Test written blind from the label alone.
